en: Truth alone triumphs
The world is one family
Yoga is excellence in action
The earth belongs to the valiant
In this age, strength lies in unity
Non-violence is the highest dharma
Speak truth. Walk in dharma.
Dharma protects those who protect it
The body is the first instrument of dharma
Mind alone binds, mind alone frees
Forgiveness is the ornament of the brave
Conduct is the highest dharma
Knowledge bestows humility
Mother and motherland surpass heaven
Helping others is merit, harming them is sin
Avoid excess in all things

sa: उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः
en: Effort accomplishes, not wishes
Arise, awake
Lead me from the unreal to the real
Lead me from darkness to light
Your right is to the work, never to its fruits
Equanimity is called yoga
The faithful gain knowledge
Lift yourself by your own self

sa: अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते
en: The mind is mastered by practice and detachment
Even a little practice protects from great fear

sa: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते
en: Nothing purifies like knowledge
From anger comes delusion
May all be happy
May none suffer
Win knowledge by moments, wealth by grains

sa: आलस्यं हि मनुष्याणां शरीरस्थो महान् रिपुः
en: Laziness is the enemy living within
There is no friend like effort
Contentment is the highest gain
Good company is the highest path
No letter is without power
Kind words please all beings
Why be a miser with words?
Knowledge is the highest wealth
True knowledge is that which liberates
I am the infinite
That thou art
Consciousness is the infinite
This self is the infinite
Truth is one, the wise call it by many names
Keep moving, keep moving
There is no eye like knowledge
There is no austerity like truth
Dependence is sorrow, self-reliance is joy
The night will pass, a fine dawn will come
The great are one in thought, word, and deed
The wise pass their time in learning
